//= Warper
//============================================================
prontera,156,182,5	script	Market Warper#to_prt_mk1	477,{
	cutin "prt_soldier.bmp", 2;
	mes "[Guide]";
	mes "I can guide you to Prontera Market Street if you want me to.";
	mes "How may I assist you today?";
	next;
	switch(select("Move to Prontera Market Street:Nothing")) {
	case 1:
		mes "[Guide]";
		mes "Sure, I will guide you there.";
		close2;
		warp "prt_mk",161,148;
		end;
	case 2:
		mes "[Guide]";
		mes "Please come back and ask me if you want me to guide you to Prontera Market Street.";
		close3;
	}
}

//= Warper to Training Ground
//============================================================
prontera,170,179,3	script	Training Instructor#1	4_M_JOB_KNIGHT1,{
		mes "[Instructor]";
		mes "I can send you to the upper or lower training ground. Where do you want me to send you to?";
		set .@menu$, "Upper Training Ground:Lower Training Ground";
		switch(select(.@menu$)) {
		case 1:
		warp "tra_fild",104,168;
			break;
		case 2:
		warp "tra_fild",106,79;
			break;
		}
}
